NYC October Trip

Nine days planned as walking routes. Pick a day to see its route on the map and its stops in order. Drag and pinch the map to zoom into the streets. Round pins are sights and square pins are food. Every stop is labelled From your list (your saved places, your lists and requests) or My pick; dashed pins are my picks or optional stops. Use the buttons above the map to show other days' stops, saved places and new openings near the route; tap any pin to see what it is and which day it belongs to.

        FoodWhenNote

        Times are a guide, not a timetable. Walking routes follow real streets and paths (OpenStreetMap data), steered through the nicer blocks; walking times assume an easy 4.7 km/h. Opening hours, free-entry rules and Smorgasburg's end-of-season date were checked in early October 2026; confirm them a few days before. Subway, bus, ferry and tram all accept OMNY: tap the same contactless card or phone each time, one per person.
